question.text: Section VIII of the PPM — 'Principles of Portfolio Valuation' — applies:

answer.text: To Category I and II AIFs only, specifying the Valuer, frequency, IPEV guidelines usage etc.
Only to Category III AIFs due to their daily NAV obligations.
To all AIFs uniformly, including Angel Funds.
Only to AIFs registered after June 2020.

explanation.text: The Logic: Per the workbook (page 185), PPM Section VIII 'Principles of Portfolio Valuation' is scoped to Category I and II AIFs only. It discloses the Valuer of the Fund/Scheme, frequency of valuation (page 275 confirms at least once every six months), and whether the IPEV Guidelines are applied. The Trap: Option B is wrong because Section VIII is Cat I/II specific, not a Cat III section. Option C is wrong because not all AIFs are covered (Angel Funds and Cat III fall outside). Option D invents a registration-date carve-out the workbook does not describe. Note: Use only the workbook's scoping — Cat I and II AIFs, valuer/frequency/IPEV disclosures — without adding valuer-rotation planning prescriptions.
